subject: Re: Packaging options for pilot — credits ladder and modular add-ons
messages:

Date: 2026-12-01T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Packaging options for pilot — NimbleHealth

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising. We're trying to structure a 3-month pilot to validate two main workflows: (1) clinical note summarization (high token output, moderate concurrency) and (2) embeddings for semantic search. Our procurement team has a constrained cap for Q1, so we'd prefer a credits-style pilot rather than an open seat contract.

A few specific asks:
- Can you outline a credits ladder (pilot purchase size / discount / expiry) and whether pilot credits can convert to committed capacity if we move to production?
- Are add-on modules (dedicated KV cache, higher batching, private VPC) sold as one-time add-ons vs monthly? Can those be trialed during the pilot?
- Any proration rules on upgrades/downgrades mid-quarter?

Also looping in Jeff from procurement for invoicing/PO questions. Can you share a short proposal and a pricing matrix we can drop into our internal review?

Thanks,
Susan
Susan Park
Head of Platform, NimbleHealth
(susan.park@nimblehealth.com)

Subject: Re: Packaging options for pilot — credits ladder and modular add-ons

Hi Susan — great meeting, appreciate the specifics. Attaching a short proposal and our pricing matrix for the pilot scenarios (see attachments). Below is an executive summary to make procurement review easier.

Proposal highlights (pilot-first approach):
- Pilot structure: 3-month credits purchase. We propose a two-tier ladder so you can match spend to early usage: 
  * Small pilot: $25k credits (10% off list) — intended for single-team validation (~100k-300k tokens/day)
  * Large pilot: $75k credits (15% off list) — covers both summarization + embeddings, reserve KV cache for bursts
- Credit expiry: 12 months from invoice date.
- Conversion: Up to 50% of pilot credits may be converted to committed capacity credit within 30 days of contract signature (conversion gives an additional 5% conversion bonus credit).
- Add-ons:
  * Dedicated KV cache (monthly): billed as a monthly SKU; we can include a 30-day free trial of the cache during the pilot if you select the large pilot.
  * VPC/private control plane: one-time onboarding fee + monthly infra surcharge (trial possible on staging only).
- Proration: Upgrades are prorated daily for the remainder of the billing month; downgrades take effect at month boundary unless you choose immediate prorate with a small admin fee.
- Onboarding credit: we can offer a one-time $10k onboarding credit toward professional services for the large pilot.

Next steps: If this matches your budget envelope, I can send an NG-1 SOW and a pricing worksheet formatted for your procurement team. Happy to jump on a 30-min call with Jeff to walk through PO/invoicing.

Thanks — 
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: nimble-proposal-v2.pdf, redwood-pricing-matrix.csv

Thanks Karthik — this looks useful. A few procurement clarifications before we loop legal: 
- Invoicing cadence: do you support net-30 on invoice for pilot purchases? We prefer net-30 for faster internal approvals.
- PO process: will Redwood accept a company PO for the pilot amount?
- Proration/cancellation: confirm that pilot credits will not be refunded but can be converted per the conversion rules. Is there any early termination liability if we convert to a committed contract and later reduce committed capacity?
- Tax and billing entity: can you confirm Redwood billing entity and whether you charge US sales tax for our jurisdiction?

If you can drop answers in bullet form and a short line we can include in the PO, that would expedite things.

—Jeff
Jeffrey Li
Procurement Manager, NimbleHealth

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jeffrey Li <jeffrey.li@nimblehealth.com>, Susan Park <susan.park@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-02T13:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Packaging options for pilot — procurement clarifications

Hi Jeff — answers inline to keep this PO-friendly: 

- Invoicing cadence: yes, we support net-30 for pilot purchases (standard on the invoice).
- PO process: we accept company POs for pilot amounts. Please include the HubSpot deal id (ND-2026-1042) on the PO.
- Proration/cancellation: pilot credits are non-refundable. Conversion rules: up to 50% conversion within 30 days; if you convert to a committed capacity contract and later reduce capacity, the committed contract has a 90-day stepdown window (no refunds) to avoid capacity churn. Early termination fees only apply to multi-quarter committed contracts, not to pilot credits.
- Billing entity / tax: Redwood Inference, Inc. (billing: Redwood Inference, Inc., 250 Market St, San Francisco, CA). We follow jurisdictional tax rules; typically US customers are charged sales tax where applicable — we will provide a tax line on the invoice.

Other commercial notes:
- Discount ladder: our published conversion path is 15% list discount at $300k annualized commit, 25% at $600k. For the pilot -> committed conversion we can extend an extra 3% for first-year commitments signed within 60 days of conversion.
- Add-on trialability: the dedicated KV cache trial is available for up to 30 days on staging; private VPC trial is a technical evaluation only and requires a brief network workshop (we can waive the one-time onboarding fee for the staging evaluation).

I'll prepare a short PO-ready paragraph and share it to this thread and the HubSpot deal. Lauren/Connor — could you please prepare the PO paragraph and an SOW stub we can send to Nimble?

Karthik

Susan
